documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Under Regulation 29 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Revised Intimation Under Reg 30 Read With Schedule III Of SEBI (LODR ) Regulations, 2015
Intimation Under Reg 30 Read With Schedule III Of SEBI (LODR ) Regulations, 2015
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong start to Q1 FY27 with significant year-on-year growth in pre-sales, collections, revenue, and profit after tax. Management reaffirmed its full-year guidance for pre-sales, revenue growth, and profit margins, supported by a robust ongoing and upcoming launch pipeline of residential and commercial redevelopment projects in Mumbai and the surrounding region. The company maintains a strong net-cash balance sheet with low debt levels and substantial projected future cash flows from completed, ongoing, and upcoming developments. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported robust financial and business performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, driven by strong pre-sales, revenue growth, and collections. Management highlighted successful new project launches, including Lotus Trident and Lotus Aquaria, and outlined a healthy launch pipeline for the remainder of the fiscal year.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, and revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA and PAT margins to be sustained at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30% respectively.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: Management is confident of achieving FY27 pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, revenue growth of 55% to 60%, and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this robust launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we are confident of achieving our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue growth of 55% to 60% and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11% led by upgraders.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai is a good example of this. Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury buyers are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle rather than loan rates.
demand_outlook.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not. They are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle, not by loan rates.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces in the GIFT City project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Newly launched projects are experiencing good traction, enquiries, and strong customer interest.
demand_outlook.quote: Both projects were launched towards the end of June and are seeing good traction and enquiries, with construction commenced and strong customer interest, providing a healthy pipeline for future sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted sustained demand in the premium housing segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Backed by a growing portfolio, strengthening brand equity, and sustained demand in the premium housing segment, we remain confident in delivering our growth objectives for the year while continuing to execute with financial discipline and operational excellence.

demand_outlook.claim: The luxury residential segment is outperforming the broader residential market, supported by robust end-user demand, rising aspirations, and sustained interest from HNIs and NRIs.
demand_outlook.quote: Even amid global uncertainty and geopolitical developments, luxury residential segment is clearly outperforming the broader residential market, supported by robust end-user demand, rising aspirations, and sustained interest from HNIs and NRIs.

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project in Juhu with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

capex_expansion.claim: Four more projects are planned for launch over the remainder of FY27 with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its development portfolio with the launch of Lotus Trident in Andheri West and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we further expanded our development portfolio with the launch of Lotus Trident in Andheri West and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch four new projects with a combined estimated GDV of INR 3,500 to 4,000 crores in the remaining part of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The company plans to launch four new projects in the remaining part of FY27, with an estimated combined GDV of ~INR 3,500–4,000 Crs.

capex_expansion.claim: The GIFT City mixed-use project has an estimated GDV of INR 2,000 to 2,200 crores with expected commencement in Q1 FY28 and completion in FY31.
During FY26, the company added nine new projects with a cumulative GDV of approximately INR8,500 crores to INR9,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During FY26, we added nine new projects with a cumulative GDV of approximately INR8,500 crores to INR9,000 crores, significantly strengthening our development pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: During the year, the company marked its strategic entry into GIFT City.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, we also marked our strategic entry into GIFT City, further expanding our geographic presence.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores at a PAT margin of 34.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 PAT margin was reported at 34.5%.
The company maintains consistent PAT margins in the range of 25% to 30%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin (%) ~ 25%-30% on a consistent basis

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have risen by approximately 7%, while labor costs have increased by around 5%.
margins_costs.quote: Input costs have risen by approximately 7%, while labor costs have increased by around 5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 39.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 39.4% for the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of 22 projects in the pipeline, 17 are redevelopment-led.
orders_capacity.quote: Notably, 17 of these 22 projects are redevelopment-led, reinforcing our core focus and competitive strength in this segment.

orders_capacity.claim: The portfolio comprises a total carpet area of approximately 4.0 million sq. ft. and saleable area of approximately 3.2 million sq. ft. excluding sold inventory.
orders_capacity.quote: Carpet Area* ~4.0mn. Sq. ft. Saleable Area* ~3.2mn. Sq. ft.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q4 FY26 stood at INR462 crores, registering a strong growth of 177% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales for Q4 FY26 stood at INR462 crores, registering a strong growth of 177% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: For the full year ended March 2026, the company achieved pre-sales of INR1,157 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: For the full year ended March 2026, we achieved pre-sales of INR1,157 crores, in line with our stated guidance, despite industry-wide challenges.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, total cash balance was approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR550 crores earmarked for a subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, INR271 crores has been deployed as of 30th June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

capital_allocation.claim: Fresh issue proceeds from the IPO of INR 550 crores are allocated towards part-funding development and construction costs of ongoing projects Amalfi, The Arcadian, and Varun.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: Total cash stood at INR 777 crores against debt outstanding of INR 153 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: 1. Total Cash of INR 777 Crs. Debt outstanding of INR 153 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a dividend payout of 50% for FY26, and the promoter group voluntarily waived its dividend entitlement for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Before I conclude, I would like to share that the Board has approved a dividend payout of 50% for FY26. In line with its long-term growth vision, the promoter group has voluntarily waived its dividend entitlement for FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash as on 31st March 2026 stood at INR697 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash as on 31st March 2026 stood at INR697 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the net proceeds from the IPO of approximately INR732 crores, the company has deployed funds amounting to INR394 crores till March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: During the IPO, we raised approximate 792 crores through the fresh issue and net proceeds post issue expenses stood at approximate 732 crores. Out of this, we have deployed fund amounting to INR394 crores till March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company stated that its actual results could differ materially from results expressed or implied due to various economic and market factors.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company’s actual results, levels of activity, performance or achievements could differ materially and adversely from results expressed in or implied by this Presentation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing global geopolitical developments have led to a moderate increase in input and labor costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Before moving into the detailed financial, I would like to highlight that ongoing global geopolitical developments have led to a moderate increase in input and labor costs.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
management_commitments.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

management_commitments.claim: Construction activities have commenced for the newly launched projects, and management expects to launch four new projects in the remaining part of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The company plans to launch four new projects in the remaining part of FY27, with an estimated combined GDV of ~INR 3,500–4,000 Crs.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to launch three projects in H1 FY2027, namely Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, Lotus Trident, and Lotus Sky Plaza in Andheri.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we expect to launch three projects in H1 FY2027, Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, Lotus Trident, and Lotus Sky Plaza in Andheri, with a combined revenue potential of over INR2,500 crores to INR3,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving FY27 pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Backed by this robust launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we are confident of achieving our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue growth of 55% to 60% and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
